entries.title: 2026’s Best Black Friday Deals: We’ve Been Tracking Since 4 AM
entries.summary: It's time to shop the very best Black Friday deals on the very best tech gadgets we recommend.
entries.content:
The Black Friday deals have arrived! Set yourself up with a turkey sandwich and a warm drink, because it's time to shop the best sale event of the year. And after the year we've had, we could all use a few bargains to cheer us up, score that upgrade we've been needing, and get a few gifts in the bag.

Eufy Omni C28 $800 $380

The Reviews team at WIRED tracks prices on our favorite gadgets year-round, and we highlight deals only on devices we’ve tested and would recommend to our own friends and family. These are the discounts that caught our eye—vetted for price hikes and fake deals. And if you’re looking for something more distinctive and gift-worthy, we’ve curated some special finds on sale.

Updated 7 pm ET Friday, November 27: We’ve added new featured deals throughout this guide. We’ve also updated prices and removed deals no longer available.

Additional contributors: Louryn Strampe, Scott Gilbertson, Nena Farrell, Kat Merck, Molly Higgins, Boutayna Chokrane, Luke Larsen, Harry Rabinowitz, Les Shu

  • A Fun STEM Gift: ThinkFun Gravity Maze for $17 ($8 Off)
  • A Bluetooth Tracker for Your Wallet: Chipolo Card for $33 ($6 Off)
  • The Best Budget Massage Gun: Lifepro Sonic Massage Gun for $51 ($9 Off)
  • A Neck Fan We Love: JisuLife Neck Fan for $28 ($7 Off)
  • A Watch Band We Love: Moft Snap Duo for $32 ($8 Off)
  • Our Go-To Checked Bag: Away The Bigger Carry-On for $221 ($74 Off)
  • One Smart Ring to Rule Them All: Oura Ring 5 for $299 ($100 Off)
  • Apple’s Best Wireless Earbuds: Apple AirPods Pro 3 for $149 ($100 Off)
  • Nothing Beats the Price: Nothing Headphone (a) for $109 ($90 Off)
  • The New-Parent Essential: SlumberPod With Fan for $154 ($66 Off)
  • Our Favorite Affordable Robot Vacuum: Roborock Qrevo 2 Pro for $450 ($350 Off)
  • The Best Android Phone: Google Pixel 11 Pro XL for $899 ($400 Off)
  • A Rare Sale on an Excellent Sunrise Alarm: Hatch Sleep Clock for $188 ($62 Off)
  • The Perfect Small Laptop: Dell XPS 13 for $550 ($200 Off)
  • A Top OLED TV: LG C6 OLED TV for $1,400 ($1,300 Off)
  • A Do-It-All Air Fryer: Typhur Dome 2 for $285 ($105 Off)
  • Good Time: WIRED’s favorite sub-$400 dive watch is even more irresistible at 20% off.
  • For the Home: Schoolhouse has a great sale going, with quilts, shams, and hooks over 60% off.
  • It’s a Cinch: I endorse this buy-it-for-life, made-in-USA leather belt from Homestead Brand (20% off).
  • Cozy Up: Alex Mill’s wool-and-alpaca crewneck sweater is 39% off and fully stocked.
  • Go Dutch: Great Jones’ The Dutchess oven, a team favorite, is a whopping 70% off—down to $75!—and produces a mean chili.
  • Upstate Vibes: My favorite shirts for fall are from the mom-and-pop Road to Nowhere in Kingston, New York. This fantastic overshirt is 25% off online.
  • Just My Type: I love the wooden accents on our favorite mechanical keyboard, which is finally under $100.
  • On Our Trail: The iconic Salomon XT-6 trail sneaker is 40% off and stocked in all sizes.
  • For Small Pets: Howie, my 25-pound goldendoodle, says you should save 50% on the Fi Mini.
  • Top Deals: What do you get the guy with too many chore coats? A Harrington jacket—like this excellent one from Todd Snyder, which is 30% off an already half-off ticket. Todd Snyder rarely does sales these days, but this weekend is an exception.

Curated by Cooper Fleishman, executive commerce director. Updated Friday, November 27, at 2:30 pm ET.

Best Laptop Deals

The Dell XPS 13 was already a great deal, with its aggressive starting price and beautiful display. And then comes along this discount, which brings the price down to just $550. A laptop this premium for under $600 feels outrageous, even if it only comes with 8 GB of RAM and 256 GB of storage. If you’re using this for work or school, you might want to consider the upgraded 16-GB model, which is also on sale for Black Friday. There’s no laptop deal quite like it right now. —Luke Larsen

Best Apple Deals

I’ve often called the MacBook Air the laptop most people should buy. Even after testing dozens of new laptops this year, I stand by that statement. It balances price, battery life, performance, and quality in a way that’s still unbeaten by the competition. The only problem is that at its retail price of $1,299, it’s been a bit too expensive. At a full $250 off, though, it’s a must-buy. —Luke Larsen

This is a great price for AirPods Pro 3, our de facto wireless earbud of choice for anyone with an iPhone. They are stacked with some of the best automated noise-canceling and transparency modes you can get in wireless earbuds, plus other useful features like accurate heart rate tracking (so you can track workout data without a fitness tracker) and live translation. —Harry Rabinowitz

Look, we see this price often for AirPods Max 2 whenever there is a big sale event. But anything to lower their crazy $550 MSRP is noteworthy, considering how great (and popular) they are for Apple fans. They have some of the best noise-canceling and transparency modes around, plus a clear, detailed sound profile that puts wireless earbuds to shame. —Harry Rabinowitz

  • The Apple AirTag is perfect for tracking your stuff, and it's 38% off.
  • Save $100 on the Apple Watch Series 12. It's the best smartwatch for iPhone folks.
  • The budget Apple Watch SE is even cheaper than usual with a 28% discount.
  • Folks who want an Apple Pencil (USB-C) for their new iPhone Duo can get it for $30 off.
  • Get 6 months of Apple TV for $6.99 per month. That's less than half the usual price.

Best Home Office Deals

Topping my guide of the best mesh Wi-Fi systems, the Wi-Fi 7 Netgear Orbi 770 Series is perfect for most families. It’s a tri-band mesh (2.4-, 5-, and 6-GHz) offering simple setup, stable and speedy internet connectivity, and expansive coverage. The stylish tower design is unobtrusive, the internal antennas ensure your whole home gets online, and it delivers the benefits of Wi-Fi 7, including MLO (Multi-Link Operation) to enable Wi-Fi 7 devices to connect on multiple bands at once. —Simon Hill

Standing desks are often quite expensive, which is to be expected. But this is one of the few affordable standing desks worth buying. It comes in a number of different sizes, colors, and styles, and the laminated top protects against spills. It’s not the simplest to set up, but as our testers have verified, the FlexiSpot EN1 makes up for it by being such an affordable upgrade to your home office ergonomics. —Luke Larsen

I’m still astounded that you can buy a high-quality 4K monitor for such little money these days. The Dell 27 Plus is my top pick as the monitor most people should buy, and the fact that it’s nearly $200 only bolsters that recommendation even more. The only compromise is that it’s a bit limited in terms of ports, but you can upgrade to the S2725DC with USB ports. —Luke Larsen

  • The Logitech MX Keys Mini is a near-perfect low-profile keyboard. Grab it for 20% off.
  • Amazon's Eero Pro 7 mesh is $200 off for a 2-pack that will cover your home in Wi-Fi 7.
  • Hide your cables with D-Line's Mini Cable Trunking 4-Meter Pack, which is 15% off.
  • The Ugreen NAS DH4300 Plus is almost $100 off and will let you store all your files privately, no cloud needed.

Travel Deals

Created from fabric scraps that would otherwise end up in a landfill, this thoughtfully constructed bag looks great and can carry everything you need for a weeklong trip. WIRED's Gear team has loved this bag for almost a decade now, and it's still one of our favorites. The pack straps and adjustable waist belt all tuck away neatly when you don't need them, turning this Allpa into more of a soft suitcase. —Scott Gilbertson

Everything at Away Luggage is 25 percent off right now, including the Softside Carry-On, our top pick among roller bags. Multiple WIRED staffers own the hard-sided carry-on (currently $206 ($69 off) because it's good-looking and reasonably priced. However, former senior commerce editor Adrienne So prefers the brand's Softside Carry-On because it shows scuffs less easily, won't crack, and is more flexible if you overpack. —Scott Gilbertson

Deals on Headphones

The Sony XM4C are finally on sale, and all is right in the world. These are essentially a version two of the cult-classic Sony WH-1000XM4, one of our favorite headphones of 2020, and one of Sony’s best-selling headphones ever. They are really the people’s choice: excellent sound, great noise-canceling (though not as good as Bose’s), a comfortable fit, a folding design, on-ear detection, and decent battery life, all at a reasonable price. —Harry Rabinowitz

Finally, a good sale on the Sony WH-1000XM6. This is the lowest price ever for arguably the best noise-canceling headphones you can buy. They go toe-to-toe with Bose for the best noise-canceling around, have a folding, travel-friendly design, and sound absolutely stellar. They set the bar for over-ear headphones, and remain one of the pairs I test others against when writing reviews. —Harry Rabinowitz

Deals on TVs and Streaming Devices

This is probably the standout TV deal this Black Friday, if the price holds. The LG C6 has been at its lowest price ever since November started, making it the best OLED TV deal around. We’re still testing it, but early impressions are positive, just like they were for the C5 and C4 before it. —Harry Rabinowitz

Here’s the thing: Like many consumer tech companies, Roku raised prices significantly across its product lines. The Black Friday sale price for the Streaming Stick Plus With Voice Remote—our favorite streaming device for most people—was the same as the previous regular price. You once could have gotten this device for $20. Still, it’s a simple yet fantastic way to access streaming content on your TV, with support for tons of apps and easy navigation. And the current sale price makes it more palatable than the new MSRP. —Les Shu

  • Amazon’s Ember Artline, a competitor to the Samsung Frame, is down to $499 for the 55" and $699 for the 65", a cheery 29% and 36% off.

Deals on Soundbars and Home Audio

Simply the best all-in-one soundbar. If you want to upgrade your TV audio with one speaker, and not mess around with subwoofers or surround sound, just get the Sonos Arc Ultra. It delivers big, wide, and accurate sound across movies, TV shows, and music. While it’s a bit long, it’s not very tall, so it’s easy to fit in front of most TVs without blocking them. —Harry Rabinowitz

  • The Sonos Roam 2 is a portable speaker, but also doubles nicely for your home since it can still connect over Wi-Fi. It's also 22% off right now.
  • It's not the best deal we've seen on it, but the Sonos Era 300 is also on sale right now for $100 off.

Deals on Vacuums

One of our favorite cordless vacuums, the V15 Detect is an oldie but a goodie. It's a great Dyson vacuum that was our top pick for a long time because it's more affordable than the Gen5Detect and V16, but still comes with two cleaner heads (the Digital Motorbar for carpet and Fluffy Optic for hard floors) and has 240 air-watts of suction (almost 100 more than the V10 Konical and other cheaper Dyson vacuums). —Nena Farrell

The best robot vacuum I've tested is also for sale at one of the best prices I've seen it for. The Shark PowerDetect UV Reveal is smarter than most vacuums I've tested, thanks to its UV light that helps it find stains around your floors. It does a great job with corner cleaning (nailing my trickiest of corners in my tests) and navigating around my home, though it only can learn a single map, so it's not as ideal for multi-floor homes. But you can just do what my best friend did: buy one for each floor. At this price, you're almost getting it for two for one anyways. —Nena Farrell

Deals on Pet Tech

We think this is the best pet camera for most people—it’s affordable and offers 360-degree views, two-way audio, and treat dispensing. If you subscribe to Furbo’s enhanced security service, it’ll also provide daily highlights broken down by activity or motion, seven-day storage, a report with insights into your pet’s daily activities, and safety alerts about hazards like smoke or falling objects. —Molly Higgins

This pet water fountain is perfect for cats who love drinking from faucets. It features all-stainless-steel construction, which makes it more hygienic and keeps water colder. The tall spigot is great for cats who love long streams of water, and activated carbon filters sit below the steel top. Plus, the top has a reservoir, so water is always available. It's not app-connected, but the small window lets you easily monitor water levels. —Molly Higgins

Best Kindle, Tablet, and E-Reader Deals

The Kindle Paperwhite is the best of Amazon’s e-readers to buy thanks to its larger screen and warm front light, plus 16 GB of storage. The cheaper base Kindle doesn’t have any of these and loses an inch of screen space. There’s a new Kindle Paperwhite out as of late October, but only the older model is on sale. Don’t worry—you aren’t missing out on much; I recommend buying the on-sale model over the newest one, since the 12th gen is only two years old and still great. —Nena Farrell

  • If you want the cheapest Kindle you can find during Black Friday, the basic 2024 Kindle is on sale for $30 off.
  • Looking for more of a drawing tablet rather than an e-reader? Wacom's drawing tablet is 23% off and a great gift for your favorite artist or photo editor.

Kitchen and Coffee Deals

Every time blenders come up on our team, someone has to mention my personal Vitamix 5200, which I bought refurbished in 2015 (for more than this sale price!) and have used near-daily for the past 11 years. So, here is an update: Yes, it is still going. The plastic carafe suffered a crack, which didn’t affect its function, but I was able to find a replacement via Buy Nothing. Three hundred dollars is an absolute steal for a top-performing blender you will likely only have to buy once in your life. —Kat Merck

What’s the point of owning a home if you can’t have a backyard pizza oven? The Solo Stove Pi Prime is one of our favorite outdoor pizza ovens and a strong option if you want a gas variant. Besides pizza, the opening can accommodate cast-iron pans for other foods (steaks, anybody?), and it has good wind shielding. —Les Shu

The Technivorm Moccamaster KBGT Coffee Machine is drip coffee perfection. Pair it with good-quality, freshly ground beans, and you’ll have a perfect pot in precisely six minutes. This classic design has been handmade in the Netherlands since 1968, with a steel construction, a copper heating element, and a glass-lined thermal carafe. It brews at between 92 and 96 degrees Celsius, the ideal temperature to unlock those flavors. One of the best coffee makers around, it is built to last, so snag one on sale and tick coffee off your list forever. —Simon Hill

  • Our Place’s Wonder Oven Pro is 15% off. We like these sage oven mats, too.

The Best Phone Deals

Maybe the best Android phones you can buy right now, Google’s AI features are genuinely helpful, offering proactive assistance and handy photography features like Magic Capture. Pixels are also the only major Android phones with full Qi2 support, including magnets for easy mounting. The Pro models boast better cameras with faster low-light performance and powerful telephoto lenses to zoom in from afar, brighter displays, and a customizable HiLight LED on the back of the phone. This is a deep discount on this year’s flagship. —Simon Hill

This is the first discount I’ve seen on the repairable, ethically made, relatively environmentally friendly Fairphone 6. It has a bright screen, solid performance and battery life, a decent camera system, and long software support, not to mention fun modular accessories. Built in Europe, but now available in the US, this is the smartphone for folks seeking something that’s made responsibly and designed to last. —Simon Hill

Why be bored sitting on the bus, train, or plane when you could be gaming on a giant virtual screen? These glasses plug directly into many phones, tablets, gaming handhelds, and laptops to give you the equivalent of a 174-inch screen. They’re bright (1,250 nits), with a wide field of view (58 degrees) and three DoF (degrees of freedom), so you can fix your screen as you turn and rotate your head. The Viture Beast is our pick of the best smart glasses for folks seeking a wearable display. —Simon Hill

Deals on Chargers and Power Banks

This MagSafe Qi2 power bank has been a longstanding top pick. It has a built-in kickstand and a convenient display, and can be used wirelessly or wired with the included USB-C cable. It doesn’t pack enough power for more than one full charge, but it’s handy in a pinch. —Louryn Strampe

The top pick in my best travel adapters guide, this Ceptics charger has everything you need for your next trip. The sliding prongs lock securely in place and cover more than 200 countries. You get a universal input socket, an additional side socket for US or Japan plugs, and two USB-C ports and two USB-A ports on the bottom. But I love the retractable USB-C cable best of all. This is sometimes discounted by a few dollars, but I’ve never seen it this low before. —Simon Hill

  • We’d buy the Anker MagGo 2 Pro power bank for 22% off if we didn’t already own several of these.
  • Need more power for a camping trip? The EcoFlow River 2 Pro is 34% off.
  • My favorite power station, the Bluetti Elite 300, is $100 off the usual price.
  • The rugged Iniu Outdoor Power Bank doubles as a flashlight and is 15% off.

The Best Smart Home Deals

This is the best subscription-free camera for most people right now. It’s a self-contained triple-lens powerhouse, combining a 4K fixed main lens with a 130-degree field of view and dual 2K lenses that pan 360 degrees and tilt 70 degrees. You can track and zoom in on subjects or license plates more than 150 feet away. The 10,000-mAh battery is topped off by the included solar panel. And you have onboard AI and 32 GB of storage. —Simon Hill

My favorite digital photo frame after years of testing remains anything made by Aura. The base Carver and Carver Mat are both on sale for the same price, but the Carver Mat usually retails for more, so it’s a better deal. It also looks nicer, giving the appearance of mat mounting and making it look more like a real, analog framed picture than ever. Aura’s software is easy to use, offers unlimited storage, and syncs well with other apps like Google Photos. —Nena Farrell

  • The Lutron Caseta smart dimmer switches we recommend are 15% off.
  • The best of Amazon's latest smart displays, the Echo Show 11, is nearly $100 off and the perfect size for kitchen counters.

Deals on Toys and Games

This irresistible construction kit from our best STEM toys guide is a wonderful gift for kids of all ages. Clixo’s colorful, versatile, magnetic pieces snap together, enabling you to build all kinds of three-dimensional shapes, from crowns to cats. The pieces stack neatly and are very compact when packed away, they’re durable and washable, and you can play with them anywhere—you don’t need a table. Clixo kits are suitable for kids aged 4 and up, but teens and even adults will get a kick out of these too. —Simon Hill

  • The strategy game Catan is on sale for half its usual price.
  • You can get the fun card game Exploding Kittens for 50% off.
  • Clever logic puzzle Rush Hour Deluxe from ThinkFun is discounted by $8 right now.

Camera Deals

  • Canon AE-1 Program (used) is 10 percent off. Want to use a cool vintage camera but still, y’know, get the shot? This 1981 Canon has an auto mode to help. —Harry Rabinowitz
  • Fujifilm X100V (used) is 10 percent off. The EDC camera that broke the internet during the pandemic. Unlike the new X100VI, this version is actually in stock if you buy used. —Harry Rabinowitz
  • Lexar 128GB Silver Go Micro SD Card is 22 percent off. Another good memory card deal; I like this for my GoPro. —Scott Gilbertson
  • Lexar 256GB 2000x SD Card is 20 percent off. The memory card I’ve been using for 10 years. —Scott Gilbertson
  • Lexar 256GB Dual Drive D500 External SSD is 33 percent off. You know what’s 10 times faster than trying to transfer data over WiFI? Throwing it on a tiny SSD Stick like this one. —Scott Gilbertson
  • Samsung's T9 Portable SSD is 29 percent off. This has been my go-to portable drive for backing up photos on the go. —Scott Gilbertson

Fitness and Outdoor Deals

A smaller design, better fitness features, and smart privacy additions make this Oura's best ring yet. WIRED reviewer Boutayna Chokrane says the Oura Ring 5 is so sleek she sometimes forgets she's even wearing it. The data is pretty similar to what she saw on the Ring 4, so you don't need to upgrade if you already have that model, but with its Black Friday pricing it's a great time to buy if you want this ultra-sleek smart ring.

Though no longer the newest model in Google’s lineup, the 2023 Fitbit Charge 6 continues to stand out as an entry-level fitness tracker. It offers a comprehensive suite of wellness features without swamping you in excessive metrics. Compatible with both iOS and Android platforms, it integrates smoothly with Google Maps, YouTube Music, and compatible exercise machines like NordicTrack treadmills and Peloton bikes. For those who don’t care about built-in GPS functionality, the Fitbit Inspire 3 is on sale for $70 and is just as accurate as a wearable. —Boutayna Chokrane

As my favorite walking pad, the Urevo CyberPad rarely drops this low in price. Its standout feature is a 14-percent incline, making it one of the steepest models we’ve tested. Weighing 71 pounds, moving it around can be tricky despite the integrated wheels, but that solid build ensures smooth, steady belt operation even at its maximum 4 mph speed. While not dead silent, its noise level is low enough that it won’t disrupt your workflow. —Boutayna Chokrane

entries.title: Yeti Coolers Are up to 30% Off for Black Friday (2026)
entries.summary: Yeti’s Black Friday deals cover everything from a cooler for the tailgate to a Rambler for your desk.
entries.content:
Everyone loves Yeti. Its coolers and insulated cups are built to last and keep beers ice cold, even on the hottest days. They cost a bit more than the run-of-the-mill coolers you’ll find at a gas station, but they’re made to last a lifetime, and discounts are rare. Yeti products hardly ever go on sale, so when they do, they tend to sell out quickly. Below are several rare Yeti discounts live right now on WIRED-tested Yeti items we loved. Grab ’em before they're gone.

For more discounts on more WIRED-tech gadgets, check out our roundup of the Absolute Best Black Friday Deals.

Our Top Pick

This is the smaller version of our favorite overall cooler we tested, which kept ice frozen for six days in direct sunlight on a 90-degree-Fahrenheit day and five days in Florida heat and humidity. I've historically seen this cooler sell out within a day or so when the price drops, so if you're thinking about it, don't wait.

The Best Portable Cooler

We tested the smaller Flip 12 model of this popular, lidded soft-sided cooler, but our tester found it to be versatile and super easy to carry to the park, beach, or tailgate.

An Insulated Lunch Bag

WIRED reviewer Louryn Strampe owns and recommends this lunch bag. She likes that it's comfortable to carry even when it's overpacked, and that its flap closure is easy to open and close with one hand.

A Go Cup to Keep Things Warm or Cold

The only WIRED reviewer to have tested this exact cup is contributing reviewer Joe Ray in 2022, who did not find it stacked up against Oxo's cheaper (not on sale) Good Grips version. However, similar Yeti cups have been well-received on our team, including the Stackable Pint by former WIRED reviewer Brenda Stolyar and wine tumbler (rated a rare 9/10!) by reporter Boone Ashworth, so if you're looking for a sturdy mug, this is still worth a look at this sale price.

entries.title: The Best Black Friday Gaming Deals I’ve Found (2026)
entries.summary: Headsets, keyboards, and video games are all on sale. Here’s what we’ve found so far.
entries.content:
Between Grand Theft Auto VI and peak cozy game season, video games have me in thrall these days. I went hunting for deals to improve my setup and found discounts on accessories and games for every kind of player. Here are the best Black Friday gaming deals so far.

  • My personal favorite headset: Razer Kraken Kitty V3 Pro for $128 ($52 off)
  • Our top gaming mouse: Razer Cobra HyperSpeed for $76 ($24 off)
  • A trending VR headset: Meta Quest 3S for $297 ($50 off)
  • A rare Nintendo deal: Nintendo Switch 2 + Mario Kart World Bundle for $500 ($50 off)
  • A must-have controller: Backbone Pro for $120 ($50 off)

Best Black Friday Gaming Accessory Deals

This deal isn't particularly rare, but I like this headset enough to recommend it even at its affordable full price. It's attractive, simple, and lightweight, with a removable mic and compatibility with PC, mobile, and PlayStation or Xbox (depending on the version you go with). I did misplace my microphone's pop cover because it always got stuck in my big curly hair, but that's about as “my fault” as it gets. It has a 40-hour battery life, but it can also be fast-charged for 15 minutes to get you nine hours of playtime.

This gaming headset isn't the newest anymore, but we still like it thanks to its extreme battery life. It clocks out at 300 hours per charge, which is truly wild, especially compared to other headsets that cost this much. It's wireless and comfortable, and while this deal isn't super rare, any discount is worth highlighting on this headset, which achieved a perfect score from our reviewer.

I've been testing gaming headsets for an update to our buying guide, and I keep coming back to this option from Razer. Yes, it's pink (technically called Quartz) and has light-up RGB Razer Chroma panels on the built-in cat ears and earcups. But it also offers great quality, from its comfortable earcups to its retractable, clear mic to its balanced sound. It gets a little heavy after hours of use, but when it looks this cool, it's hard to complain, especially thanks to its wide range of compatibility.

This is only $6 more expensive than the best deal we've seen for our favorite gaming mouse. It's nearly perfect, thanks to its ultra-lightweight body combined with its features like RGB lighting and wireless charging. Its polling rate is limited to 1,000 Hz, but if that is a dealbreaker, you can pair it with the Mouse Dock Pro.

Our favorite keyboard has a clean design with low-profile switches and optional RGB lighting. It's tactile and customizable, and it might be a welcome standout if you want a great keyboard without the typical gamer aesthetic. Linear Hall effect switches, hot-swap switch sockets, and subtle wood accents seal the deal.

With respect to anyone who likes wood accents and understated design, some of us want frankly whimsical decor on our desks. I use this bright pink Razer keyboard for gaming, complete with raised keyboard stickers so I can type with my long acrylic nails. I like the magnetic wrist rest, the officelike sound, the RGB lighting, and the springy resistance of the keys that don't wear my fingers out even when I'm writing one million Black Friday paragraphs (or putting in serious work in Path of Exile 2).

This controller alone made upgrading to the PlayStation 5 worth it for me. The haptics in the triggers and controller body are dynamic and adjust based on what you're doing in-game, whether it's drawing a bow or flooring the accelerator of a car. Many different colors are on sale for Black Friday, so click through to your favorite to double-check the final price.

The best upgrade controller for Xbox is on sale in almost every finish. It features many customizable elements, including swappable control sticks, adjustable tension, and slots for additional paddles as well as a rechargeable battery.

I love every Backbone product I've ever tried. The Backbone One is still good and on sale, but for new users, I'd recommend springing for the Backbone Pro while it's on sale for Black Friday. It's just a little bit better, faster, and more robust, with a larger battery life. Backbone is designed for mobile gaming but can also work wirelessly with Xbox, PlayStation, PC, and tablets.

This is one of the better deals we've seen in a while for the Meta Quest 3S. It comes bundled with PGA Tour Golf+, including a free course and in-game credits. It's comfortable, accessible, and fun, though battery life isn't fantastic. But if your kiddos are clamoring for VR, this is the deal you want.

Saving money outright on a console is nearly impossible, but this bundle comes with a game and three months of Nintendo Switch Online at $50 off. Check out more Nintendo Switch 2 deals here.

Best Black Friday Video Game Deals

I bought Elden Ring sight unseen, at full price, having never played a Soulsborne game, and gave up on it after five minutes. Don't be like me. Get it for $15 so that way you don't feel guilty about the fact that you will never, ever beat it. Ever.

entries.title: Best Black Friday Deals on My Favorite Shark Vacuums: Up to $600 Off (2026)
entries.summary: Shark’s vacuums impress me again and again, and my favorite models are deeply discounted right now..
entries.content:
I’ve tried a lot of vacuums, so it says a lot that Shark vacuums have stayed at the top of my list. I'm not kidding when I say “a lot”; at one point this year, there were 13 different vacuums in my home for research and testing. And even then, that's far from all the vacuums that were tested on my floors this year alone. It's all part of my job as the principal cordless and robot vacuum tester here at WIRED.

Shark's vacuums have consistently done well in my tests—even better than more expensive vacuums in my side-by-side testing. Shark’s robot vacuum packs the perfect amount of smarts for the price, and I have yet to find a robot vacuum that does well enough to unseat it. The brand's stick vacuums have remained at the top of my list for the last year too. Shark's robot and stick vacuums are, in my opinion, the best of Shark's entire lineup, and they happen to be on sale for Black Friday.

Looking for more deals? Don't miss our guide to the Absolute Best Black Friday Deals. Also be sure to check out the best deals on Dyson and Roborock vacuums if you want more vacuum options. Happy shopping (and eventually cleaning!).

Shark’s Best Stick Vacuum for $170 Off

If you want a great vacuum that will clean carpets and rugs just as well as a Dyson, the Shark PowerDetect is one of the best I've tried. It easily vacuumed up sand and cereal on rugs (I actually think it did better than Dyson models in both of those tests!) and was easy to maneuver around my flooring and underneath furniture, thanks to the bend in the Shark's long neck. This is the basic version, but you can also get the Clean & Empty version for $250, which comes with a self-emptying base station.

Shark’s Best Robot Vacuum for $607 Off

Looking for something that can mop and totally automate your cleaning? The best robot vacuum I've tried is the Shark PowerDetect UV Reveal, and while it's often on sale, this is a lower sale price than I usually see it for. The PowerDetect UV Reveal uses a UV light to help the built-in camera spot stains on the floor, so the vacuum will know to come back and clean them. (It's also cute how it announces it found stains after a cleaning session.) It does a great job with corners and mopping around the house; the only downside is that it can't map multiple floors of a home.

entries.title: Best Amazon Device Black Friday Deals I’ve Found (2026): Kindles, Echo Speakers
entries.summary: From Kindle e-readers to Alexa-powered smart speakers, these are the Amazon device Black Friday sales you won't want to miss.
entries.content:
My house has been powered by Alexa and Amazon devices to some degree for the past decade. There's always an Alexa somewhere in my house, ready for a quick command, and it's an ecosystem I find myself coming back to again and again—especially since Amazon always has something new coming out to catch my eye.

While not everything is on sale from Amazon's various ecosystems (sorry if you've got an eye on one of the newest Kindles; those have yet to be on sale), there are several great Amazon devices you can get for a better price than ever during Black Friday. Here are all the best deals I've found on Amazon devices.

Looking for more discounts? Don't miss our guide to the Absolute Best Black Friday Deals. Hunting for Kindles and e-reader deals specifically? I've got a story for that, too.

  • A small but super-powerful smart speaker: Echo Dot Max for $50 ($70 Off)
  • A perfect digital photo frame for Amazon-run households: Alexa Digital Photo Frame for $115 ($85 Off)
  • My favorite Kindle deal: Kindle Scribe (3rd Gen, 2025) for $390 ($160 Off)
  • The best all-around Kindle on sale: Kindle Paperwhite (12th Gen, 2024) for $130 ($70 Off)
  • An Amazon-powered art TV: Ember Artline TV (55-Inch) for $500 ($200 Off)
  • A simple mesh Wi-Fi system with Alexa support: Eero Pro 7 for $400 ($200 Off)

Best Black Friday Deals on Amazon Echo Speakers

This is my new bedside companion. The Echo Time feels more like a second-generation Echo Spot than the actual Echo Spot that came out two years ago; I'm curious why they didn't just make this a third-gen Spot. The Echo Time brings back the larger screen of the original Echo Spot and has a fun range of customizable clock faces you can use. It has sleep sensing to wake you up in the half-hour window before your official alarm time. You'll have to place it perfectly for that feature to work, but I've liked it a lot more than I expected. It also has no camera, so you can put it in your bedroom without any worries. It's expensive for what it is, so now is a great time to pick one up for yourself.

This is another one of Amazon's newest devices, and one that I loved more than I expected. The mat-style frame nicely displays any photos you upload; I actually like the screen quality better than Skylight’s Frame, but not as much as Aura’s, if you're debating between models. You'll also get unlimited photo storage if you're an Amazon Prime subscriber, so it's a good fit for households already using Amazon. It also has Alexa built in, and it sounds surprisingly good for casual question answering and even playing music.

Best Black Friday Deals on Amazon Kindle E-Readers

As an avid note-taker, I love the Kindle Scribe. It's my go-to device to bring on a plane in case I get the itch to write a list or brainstorm an idea, while also knowing I could switch over to read my latest library book all in one device. The newer Kindle Scribes have been hard for me to recommend with the high price tag, but right now the third-gen Scribe is actually cheaper than the older second-gen model. I also really like the homepage design on the newer Scribes.

If you're looking for the classic best Kindle to buy for a lower price, it's the Kindle Paperwhite. The newer version isn't on sale, but the 12th-gen version from 2024 is still great at an unbeatable price. You could spend a little less by buying the 2024 basic Kindle on sale, but I think the larger screen, a warm-toned front light, and longer battery life are well worth the extra cost. You can also get the Signature version on sale, but I wouldn't splurge on the older Signature, as the newer Signature will be compatible with Amazon's newest Kindle accessories, like the page-turn case.

Best Black Friday Deals on Amazon’s Smart-Home Gadgets (and Amazon-Compatible Gadgets)

If you want to control more things with your Echo speaker, these compact smart plugs from Amazon let you turn various devices in your home into voice-controlled ones. The plugs are a little expensive normally, but $15 per plug is a solid deal, so you can pick up a few of these for things like lamps.

Best Black Friday Deals on Amazon TVs and Streaming Devices

If you want a TV powered by Amazon, our latest favorite from Amazon's lineup is actually its art TV. The Ember Artline is our favorite TV in Amazon’s lineup. Samsung’s The Frame feels more premium, but our team found the Artline plenty capable for displaying artwork, and it costs much less. It's a great option to get an art TV on a budget, especially during Black Friday.

If you already have a TV you love but wish it was controlled by Amazon, grabbing a Fire TV Stick will fix that. Our favorite of Amazon's streaming sticks is the Fire TV Stick 4K Max. You can get picture-in-picture from your security cameras that are connected to your Amazon ecosystem, and while it's designed with Prime Video in mind, you can install other streaming apps on here, too. You'll also get 16 GB of storage and Wi-Fi 6E support, plus Alexa voice control.

Best Black Friday Deals on Amazon Eero Mesh Wi-Fi

If you want a mesh Wi-Fi system, there's a lot to choose from these days. Eero has been around for a while and has a handful of different models, but the best one we've tried is the Eero Pro 7. It's our favorite for a simple system, and it also supports Alexa if you're already an Alexa user. Plus, newer speakers from Amazon can double as Eero extenders.

entries.title: Best Black Friday AirPods Deals I’ve Found (2026)
entries.summary: This is the lowest price I’ve ever seen the AirPods Pro 3 drop to, and there’s no telling when these discounts will change.
entries.content:
Black Friday is here, and we're seeing some great deals on our favorite tech, including AirPods. Both the flagship AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods Max 2 are on sale, knocking up to $130 off their regular prices. Whether you want pocketable earbuds for everyday use, premium noise-canceling headphones, or seamless Apple integration, these are some of the best prices I've seen recently. I don't expect these prices to go back up until after Cyber Monday, but with tech getting more expensive, I wouldn't wait too long if you've been planning to upgrade.

Want more deals? Check out our guide to the Best Black Friday Headphone Deals, the Best Black Friday Deals Under $100, and the Absolute Best Black Friday Deals.

Apple AirPods Pro 3 for $149 ($100 Off)

The flagship AirPods Pro 3 are Apple’s best AirPods yet. Upgrades include stronger noise-canceling, a new acoustic architecture for deeper bass, and redesigned ear tips for a more secure fit. The ear tips also keep my AirPods from slipping during longer runs and sweatier workouts. New tools include a built-in heart rate sensor for fitness tracking, live translation, and a camera remote to snap photos or videos on your iPhone. These earbuds are also the first AirPods to be IP57 rated against dust, sweat, and rain.

At the time of writing, they are 40 percent off at Amazon, Best Buy, Target, and Walmart. This is the lowest price I’ve ever seen them drop to. In other words, I’d grab a pair now if they’re on your wish list.

Apple AirPods Max 2 for $419 ($130 Off)

The AirPods Max 2’s newer H2 chip improves active noise cancellation and transparency mode and enables a suite of intelligent features, including conversation awareness, live translation, and improved Siri interactions. The AirPods Max 2 are designed with a new high-dynamic-range amplifier for deeper bass, more natural vocals, and cleaner highs. The ear cuffs, while plush and comfortable for longer listening sessions, do trap some heat, but I have yet to find a pair of over-ear headphones that don’t.

At $549, the AirPods Max 2 can be a tough sell, especially with so many excellent, more affordable alternatives on the market. But at $130 off, they’re a lot easier to justify, especially if you want the seamless integration that comes with Apple’s ecosystem.

entries.title: Black Friday Mattress Deals: Get Up to 55% Off (2026)
entries.summary: I’ve found great deals on our favorite WIRED-tested mattresses and sleep accessories.
entries.content:
Mattress sales come and go so often that it’s hard to determine what’s an actual deal. The times of year when we see the most legit mattress deals are Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Memorial Day, and Labor Day. And this year is no different. We’re seeing our favorite WIRED-tested bedding and mattress brands offering some of the best Black Friday deals and discounts we've seen this year. I’ll be gathering more Black Friday mattress deals throughout the weekend, so be sure to check back often for fresh discounts on these often-pricey purchases.

Note that all mattress prices below are for queen sizes unless otherwise noted, and discounts on Shop may only appear once you're in the checkout menu.

Want more deals? Check out our guide to the Best Black Friday Deals on Amazon, the Best Black Friday TV Deals, and the Best Black Friday Deals.

  • Our favorite hybrid mattress: Leesa Sapira Chill for $1,119 (30% off)
  • A combination sleep tracker and sunrise alarm clock: Hatch Sleep Clock for $188 ($62 off)

Updated November 27, 2026: I've updated mattress sales with new dates and promo codes, updated prices, and added new deals from Molecule, Organica, Layla, Perfectly Snug, Amerisleep, and Buffy.

The Best Mattress Deals

This Helix mattress has been our top pick for years and remains one of the most popular bed-in-a-box options for good reason. Its plush pillow top and medium-firm feel make it comfortable for nearly any sleeper, whether they sleep on their side, back, or stomach.

We love Helix in general, and right now the brand has 20 percent off site-wide when you use the Helix promo code BF20. It also offers special discounts, including 25 percent off Luxe mattresses with promo code LUXE25 and 30 percent off Elite mattresses with code ELITE30. (All listed Helix promo codes are valid through November 29.)

We really love this organic mattress. When we tested the Luxe model above, we found it offered a lovely balance of plush comfort and pressure relief, with just enough bounce to make it a great choice for back sleepers seeking a little extra support. But all of Birch's models are made from natural materials like wool, latex, and cotton, without any polyurethane-based foams.

Birch's Black Friday sale runs through November 29, with 25 percent off site-wide when you use the Birch promo code BF25.

The firm Bear Elite Hybrid has long been one of our top picks for back pain. Both reviewers who tested it agree that you love it more the longer you sleep on it. Bear mattresses also keep you cool, with phase-change material that absorbs body heat and copper-infused memory foam that wicks it away.

Bear Mattress has a Black Friday Sale running through November 29, with 35 percent off site-wide and a free bundle of two pillows and a mattress protector with promo code BF35.

This was former WIRED reviewer (and sleep expert) Julia Forbes’ all-time favorite mattress. She appreciated that its extra springiness provided added support and firmness, making it ideal for side sleepers.

Nolah Mattress’ Black Friday sale runs through November 29, with 35 percent off site-wide; no promo code needed.

We on the WIRED Reviews team love hybrid mattresses because they bring together the best of both worlds—memory foam and the support of inner coils. The Sapira Chill is the best hybrid mattress we've tested to date, bringing relief to our tester's back pain while absorbing excess heat through the temperature-regulating cover.

Leesa Sleep’s Black Friday Sale runs through December 8 and offers 30 percent off mattresses and 35 percent off adjustable base bundles, with no promo code needed.

Hybrids run cooler in general due to the open-spring design, and this cooling hybrid bed has a pillow top to provide a memory-foam-like feel—the best of both worlds. The initial pillow-top layer is made of ThermoPhase “cooling foam,” and the deep dimples on the top create extra airflow to keep things cool. There are 8-inch zoned coils below to give more solid support, and these beds tend to run on the firmer side, so keep that in mind when choosing between soft, medium, or firm.

During Brooklyn Bedding’s Black Friday Sale, you’ll get 30 percent off site-wide through November 29.

Instead of air chambers on each side of the mattress, as most smart beds use, Bryte uses a more traditional foundation of coils and memory foam layers. They call their coils “Bryte Balancers,” which can be adjusted for things like lumbar support or contouring, down to individual zones, in the connected app. There are also 100 firmness levels, so you can really dial in the settings to optimize for anything, stomach sleepers or folks with back pain included. The bed also tracks your sleep and provides sleep metrics like sleep phases, hours of sleep, heart rate, respiratory rate, and the number of bed rebalances.

The Bryte mattress sale offers 20 percent off site-wide and a free Cozy Earth Bamboo Cooling Sheet Set with purchase, through November 29.

We love these smart beds from Sleep Number. (Read our review of the ComfortNext Lux Smart Bed here.) They offer balanced pressure that’s ideal for side sleepers, plus cushioning for pressure points, motion isolation, helpful sleep tracking, and customizable firmness. The ComfortNext even has built-in sleep tracking, which monitors your nightly sleep score, called your “SleepIQ” score, within the app. That data is compared with the firmness level you choose, known as your “Sleep Number” setting. This helps you fine-tune the firmness that, based on your sleep-tracking data, helps you sleep better.

The ComfortNext line, including the Lux Smart Bed model above, is 20 percent off. Sleep Number's Climate Collection is 25 percent off, and sheet sets and pillows are BOGO 50 percent off—check out all of Sleep Number's current sales and eligible items here. The offer runs through December 7, and no promo code is needed.

This is probably the most luxurious smart bed the WIRED Reviews team has ever tested. (Read our review here.) You're probably not planning to drop 10 grand on a bed today, but if you've been curious about smart beds, this may be a good one to check out. It has a unique design centered on temperature control, with built-in fans that make its surface noticeably cooler to the touch. The bed also monitors your bedroom's air quality and analyzes sleep metrics with an AI-powered sleep coach to give you feedback.

You can save $500 and get a $300 credit toward a future purchase when you buy a Tempur-ActiveBreeze System, Tempur-Breeze, or Tempur-LuxeAdapt mattress and a Tempur-Ergo Smart Base through December 1, with no promo code necessary.

When I die, bury me with this modular, supremely cooling mattress. It's part of Bedgear's new Night Ice collection, the coolest beds I've ever slept on. It has a silky cover that's cool to the touch, top layers that work together to dissipate heat effectively, and side mesh vents to increase airflow throughout the mattress. You can choose the same or different levels of firmness on both sides of the mattress.

The M5 above, plus Hybrid Performance and Sport Performance models below, are all discounted, and you can get a further discount if you buy one with an adjustable base. Sales run through December 7.

Former WIRED reviewer (and sleep expert) Julia Forbes thought this responsive hybrid mattress delivered firm support that helped with spine alignment and good pressure relief. (Read the review here.) The quilted top foam layer contours the hips and chest, and the layers of foam and pocketed coils offer good lumbar support, making it ideal for stomach sleepers or those with back pain.

During DreamCloud's Black Friday Sale, you can get up to 60 percent off mattresses and $100 off all memory foam mattresses.

If you suffer from back pain or are a stomach sleeper, we recommend a firmer, more supportive mattress like the ones above from Plank. The firm model above is very sturdy, and the firm luxe version is a hybrid mattress that adds coiled support and is flippable, with different levels of firmness on each side.

During Plank’s Black Friday Sale, you’ll get 30 percent off site-wide through November 29.

This luxe model from Essentia was the first organic mattress I tested, and I’ve been spoiled since. The Tatami is vegan, so it contains no wool or other animal byproducts. It also has a nontoxic, allergy-free Kevlar fabric barrier. It doesn't have springs, but it's super comfortable, and its foam gently conforms to your body’s curves and pressure points.

Essentia’s Black Friday sale runs through November 29, with 25 percent off site-wide, and you’ll get two free latex Cloud pillows (a $399 value) with the purchase of a mattress.

We recommend this customizable organic mattress for side sleepers as an especially great option for couples. Its modular design lets each person choose a different firmness level, with a top cover that holds separate layers of foam and wrapped coils in place. You can adjust the firmness on either side of the bed to suit your individual preferences. During the 100-night trial, you can swap comfort layers for free to try a different firmness, to ensure you've found the perfect feel.

Naturepedic's Black Friday Sale runs through tonight and offers 20 percent off site-wide, plus 25 percent off all bedding and the Concerto Organic Pillowtop Mattress, with no promo code needed.

If you’re looking for an organic mattress that will last a long time, this US-made bed offers a 100-night trial, a 20-year warranty, free shipping, and free returns. It's made with nontoxic, fiberglass-free materials and carries the certifications you want in an organic mattress, including Standard 100 Oeko-Tex, Rainforest Alliance, and Eco-Institut. While this organic mattress was too plush for my taste, if you’re looking for a softer option, it’s a solid and surprisingly affordable choice.

During Amerisleep’s Black Friday Sale, you can get $600 off select mattresses and 40 percent off adjustable bed frames with a mattress purchase with code BFCM, 20 percent off pillows and bamboo sheets with code BFCM20, and 40 percent off upholstered bed frames with a mattress purchase and 25 percent off mattress toppers, with no code needed.

This copper-infused hybrid mattress aims to move heat away, while coils add lift and stability for better back support. The five zones of RecoveryFLO provide even more support and breathability underneath, and it also features AirTEC foam with enhanced airflow compared to traditional memory foam. It has a medium-firm feel and is also available in all-foam.

Molecule's Black Friday Sale runs through November 27, with $800 off the Engage Elite 14-inch mattress, $300 off the Reflex Elite 14-inch and Engage 12/13-inch mattresses, $200 off CopperWell mattresses, 40 percent off sateen performance sheets, and 30 percent off the CopperWell Topper & Pillow, using code BF26.

This was the first mattress I tested for our guide to the best cheap mattresses, and I'm still impressed by how comfortable it was for roughly the price of a nice dinner out. It feels plusher—perhaps medium-soft—than its listed medium firmness, so I'd recommend this bed to people who prefer a plush feel. It has four layers of hypoallergenic, green-tea-infused gel memory foam, along with low motion transfer and a breathable design to help you sleep cool.

Zinus's Amazon deals offer up to 30 percent off select mattresses and bed frames and run until November 30.

entries.title: Best Black Friday Espresso Machine Deals: Up to 38% Off (2026)
entries.summary: A Nespresso under $100, $250 off a slim De’Longhi, and more deals on machines we’d make room for on our own counters.
entries.content:
If the barista at your neighborhood coffee shop knows your order before you even walk up to the counter, it might be time to consider learning to make that double Americano at home. Lucky for you, there's no shortage of Black Friday espresso machine deals on a variety of options, including a basic De’Longhi selling for less than $200, an old-school machine handmade in Milan, and much more.

Each deal below is for a machine that a WIRED reviewer has tested and vetted in their own kitchen. For more savings, check out our Best Black Friday Deals.

Featured Machines

All Diletta Machines Are on Sale at Seattle Coffee Gear

WIRED reviewers have tried and liked a couple of machines from Diletta, a line of Italian-made, classic semiautomatics exclusive to Seattle Coffee Gear, and they’re all on sale today through December 14.

Worth the Hype and 20% Off

Fellow set some pretty lofty expectations with the release of its sleek Aiden coffee maker in 2024, and according to former WIRED reviewer and espresso expert Matthew Korfhage, the brand didn't disappoint on its first attempt at an espresso machine. The ability to adjust flow rates and pressure curves was once the province of, as Korfhage put it, only the “richest and nerdiest of nerds.” But Fellow now allows you—yes, you, at home in your kitchen—to fine-tune how water moves through the grounds, unlocking previously unforeseen dimensions of flavor.

Our Favorite Super-Automatic Is 23% Off

When we tested this machine, we liked it for a variety of reasons, including an easy-to-use milk frother and two swappable bean hoppers, which are especially helpful if you like to switch to decaf in the afternoons. It comes in a variety of finishes, but note that Beige is the cheapest of all right now, at only $915.

Save $300 on a Stylish Meraki

This flashy, design-oriented semiautomatic (“a steampunk gasworks of a thing,” according to Korfhage) is quite dramatic in person. It has a dual boiler—meaning you can froth milk at the same time you’re pulling a shot—and it comes with a nice set of accessories, including a tamper and milk pitcher. Note that this sale is on the second-gen machine, which features expanded grinder settings and a new portafilter.

The Breville We’ve Used for 7 Years

The Best Semiautomatic Machine for Most People, the Barista Express is a longtime Reviews team favorite and platonic ideal of an espresso machine, with its pressure gauge and industrial-looking steam wand. If you want a built-in grinder without dropping four figures, this is your machine and your sale.

Our Favorite Under $200

Formerly the Linea Classic, De’Longhi’s Classic is the best bare-bones espresso machine we’ve tried, with a pressure gauge, 15-bar pump, and updated thermoblock system. I used one for a full year and, while it’s not as foolproof as a semiautomatic, it was easy enough for morning espresso shots and cappuccinos; I even pulled off some rudimentary latte art with its steam wand.

A Nespresso Machine for Under $100

The Vertuo Pop+ is our favorite pod maker for espresso. The Deluxe model adds a larger, side-mount water tank (37 ounces to the original’s 25 ounces) and new finishes, including this white one, a matte black-and-gold, and a sort of gunmetal gray.

Drip Coffee for Coffee Nerds

OK, yes, this is not an espresso machine, but it is Korfhage's personal favorite coffee maker. “No device I know makes single-mug drip coffee this delicious with such ease and simplicity,” he writes in his review of the machine. It's perfect for just one or two people who don't need an entire carafe's worth of joe in the morning but also enjoy pour-over-style coffee and have no desire to futz with a Chemex.

Save $250 on a Slim-Profile De’Longhi

When we reviewed this semiautomatic in 2024, we appreciated its slim profile, consistent shots, and built-in burr grinder. The cold-brew setting is more of a gimmick than a way to make actual cold brew, and some design choices are a bit quirky. Even so, it’s a beautiful, industrial-looking machine that takes up only 12 inches of counter space.

Score $100 Off Ninja Luxe Cafe Premiere

Ninja sometimes has a reputation for doing too much, but this semiautomatic is a solid beginner-friendly option that pulls good shots. It’s got a built-in grinder and milk frother, the latter of which can make cold foam and even has a setting for plant-based milk. In true Ninja fashion, the machine also has settings for drip coffee and cold brew, but neither impressed our tester, so I wouldn’t buy it for those features alone.

A Crowd Pleaser for $400 Off

In May of this year, WIRED’s UK team did a blind taste test of espresso made with a variety of machines, including the Terra Kaffe TK-02 (below) and this Philips Café Aromis 8000 Series. The Philips won overall for its flavorful, balanced espresso and lattes. Our US Reviews team will be testing the Philips soon for our own guide, but you can see what the fuss is all about ahead of that with this 20-percent-off deal.

Cold Espresso for Less

Our favorite pod machine for cold brew also has an Espresso setting that dispenses 2-ounce shots of espresso-style concentrate—perfectly chilled for iced coffee drinks. This is a huge machine and a huge investment (it only takes proprietary pods that cost more than $2 apiece), but if you have much love for cold coffee drinks (or espresso martinis) and little time to mess with a toddy or other manual machine, it will get you top-tier results within minutes.

Deals on Terra Kaffe

Korfhage tested Terra Kaffe's newer Demi and said it was perhaps the “dead-simplest fully automatic espresso machine I've yet encountered that still makes good coffee,” with just a dial and a button. Right now it's $200 off, or $300 off with a coffee subscription (Terra-Kaffe offers a house blend specifically made for its own machines). Its bigger sibling, the TK-02, impressed our tester with its convenience, ease of use, front-facing water filter, and milk carafe. Though it didn't come out on top during an espresso blind taste test we conducted earlier this year, it's still a great-looking machine that's easy to use. It's also a whopping $400 off (or $500 with a coffee subscription) for Black Friday.

If You’d Rather Give Coffee

Maybe you or your recipient already has an espresso machine; in that case, they’ll need some quality beans. Our favorite coffee subscription, Atlas Coffee Club, has a new gift option on offer for Black Friday: a quarterly subscription of three bags of unique, globally sourced coffee every three months for $59. You can choose any roast you want, including espresso roast and even Nespresso pods. If you’d rather buy an ongoing subscription for yourself, your first bag is free with Atlas’ Black Friday sale.
